newsitem.title: UK: JLT, CE Heath chiefs say no truth in merger talk.
newsitem.headline: JLT, CE Heath chiefs say no truth in merger talk.

text.p: Chief executives at London market brokers Jardine Lloyd Thompson and CE Heath told Reuters on Friday there is no basis in talk that they are to merge.
Industry sources had suggested that that Lloyd's of London was "awash with speculation" that the two were on the verge of coming together.
"I can categorically say there is no way that can be true, " CE Heath chief executive Michael Keir told Reuters.
"I have heard several merger rumours involving other firms going round, but this one is news to me", he said.
Ken Carter, chief executive of Jardine Lloyd Thompson (JLT) said: "There is no basis in this rumour".
